$Comment: Favor at the Feast: the name, picture and limits of the game's reputation group of the same id
Cap is the most favor earning can reach: Exalted's floor, so Head of the Table is as far as it goes.
Ranks renames the library's ranks for Martha alone; a rank left out keeps the library's name, and a
lock on one of these ranks reads the name written here. Order places her on the Reputation page
after Old Jack and the Hallowed. Favor comes from the Reputation rewards on her quests and board jobs
and from her daily greeting. No gear adds to it, so there is no Gear group.
The ranks open things up: Friendly the meat pie recipe and a second Field job, Honored a second
Kitchen job, Revered (Family) the Caesar salad recipe at her stall, and Exalted (Head of the Table)
the achievement harvest_feast_head_of_the_table and its title.
